end.summary:
Practised examples of diversity in Indian languages, foods, dress and festivals.
Identified shared threads such as common festival ideas, seasonal cycles, harvest gratitude and family togetherness.
Explained that different customs can exist alongside shared identity and values.
The initial idea of a common value was mixed up with clothing functions, then corrected through the seasonal-idea example; teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Riya practised comparing different regional customs and finding what they share. They gave examples such as Pongal, Holi, Diwali, languages, foods and clothing, and later used harvest gratitude and family togetherness as shared threads. There was a brief mix-up between a shared value and the purpose of clothing, which was corrected later using the common seasonal idea. At home, ask Riya to compare two festivals using the frame “different in ___, shared in ___.”
